# Pocket Reminder

A reusable ten-turn reminder demonstrating item activation, persistent character tasks and duplicate-scheduling prevention.

## How to play

Enable in a new world to receive a reminder. Activate it, then spend ten game turns; a message rings once. Activating while pending does not queue duplicates. Craft from one scrap piece with a rock.

Item ID: `ccb_pocket_alarm`; MOD ID: `pocket_alarm`.
Baseline: `0.Ag-Candidate-2026-09-05-0219`, Lua API 1.

An original CCB-maintained teaching MOD, not a third-party community submission.
Compatible with the other examples in this repository. In-game text displays English and Chinese together; it does not assume an external MOD translation loader.
Use a new test world; do not remove item-adding MODs from important saves.
